transcriber_notes: Avanet page saved as JPEG (7.95 px/cm). Site printed 'Fairview Mountain, Alberta' although the file name says Saddle Pass; recorded as printed, record_id unchanged. Boundaries printed on the right axis (119, 104, 92, 77, 75, 71, 70, 48, 43, 40, 20, 0) and agree with bar edges (75, 71, 70, 43, 40 labels offset by slanted leaders). Hardness from bar ends on the I/K/P/1F/4F/F grid (379/499/619/739/859/979 px; thirds as +/-): 781 px (two-thirds from 4F toward 1F) -> 1F-, 700 px (one-third from 1F toward P) -> 1F+. Temperature is a red line without point markers: break points 100, 90, 80, 70, 50, 40, 30, 20, 10 cm and ends 119/0 cm, read on the top axis (21.4 px/C; the dashed air line reaches -6.0 C at the top, matching the header); measured values all within 0.06 C of 0.5 C steps and recorded at those steps (+-0.1 C). Two leaders (Nov. 27th CR at 76 cm, Oct. 31 CR at 42 cm) point inside thin crust layers rather than at a boundary.
